

One pair `deploy/base/migrations/NEW-review-surface.{up,down}.sql`. Up: the
six `CREATE TABLE` statements and the indexes of WL-REQ-1322 v3, spelled as
the catalogue spells them: `reviews` (one of `task_id`, `doc_id`, `rule_id`
under `reviews_one_subject`; `subject` in `change`, `doc`, `rule`;
`next_seq`), `task_reviewers`, `review_rounds`, `review_guides`,
`review_threads` (one of `doc_id`, `rule_id`, `task_id` under
`review_threads_one_subject`; `version`, `byte_start`, `byte_end`, `quote`
nullable together; `doc_anchor`; the change columns; `intent`,
`intent_classifier` in `jev`, `default` or null, `intent_confidence`;
`status`; indexes on open threads per review, on `(doc_id, doc_anchor)` and
on `(rule_id, version)`), `review_messages` (`seq` unique per `review_id`
where it is set, unique per `thread_id` where `review_id` is null: two
partial unique indexes). `doc_notes` is untouched here; Task 6 folds it.

Down drops the six tables in FK order.
